Diagonal: the point is on the endpoint diagonal and both coordinates are strictly between their respective endpoint coordinates. Endpoints and off-line points are false.
instructions.scope: Use all pieces in state. Endpoints do not block. If endpoints are not aligned horizontally, vertically or diagonally, answer false.
